Anji Microelectronics.why: CMP slurry and process-chemical supplier to wafer fabs and advanced-packaging lines; more wafer starts and new packaging processes (TSV, TGV, hybrid bonding) raise slurry consumption
Anji Microelectronics.evidence: Anji Microelectronics investor Q&A (09-23-2026): at domestic customers it is the preferred supplier of TSV, TGV, hybrid-bonding and polymer polishing slurries, sales keep ramping, overseas validation progressing

players.product: CMP slurries (including TSV, TGV, hybrid-bonding and polymer slurries for advanced packaging), functional wet chemicals (post-CMP cleans) and plating chemistries

quarterly_data.quarter: Anji Microelectronics investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SSE e-Interactive: its advanced-packaging polishing slurries for TSV, TGV, hybrid bonding and polymer are progressing smoothly; at domestic customers it is the preferred (first-choice) supplier helping customers open up their technology routes and keeps developing products for their new processes, with sales continuing to ramp; it is also working with overseas customers, where product validation is progressing smoothly, and keeps developing custom slurries for new materials.

quarterly_data.quarter: Anji Microelectronics investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SSE e-Interactive that several silica-sol products developed by an associate company it holds a stake in have clearly improved functionality, stability and output and are used in volume production in several of its slurries, with sales continuing to ramp; testing of part of its self-made abrasives in its own products is progressing smoothly, and for now the self-made abrasives will be used only in its own products. It keeps a diversified raw-material supply through in-house development, cooperation and external purchasing.
